cases.name: tree_glob_lists_matching_files_at_any_depth
cases.about: a glob lists every file beneath the path whose name matches, past max_depth, files only, skipping what a walk skips, and echoes the glob

cases.name: tree_glob_question_mark_is_one_character
cases.about: '?' is exactly one character, so ?.dart finds a.dart and b.dart, never ab.dart

cases.name: tree_glob_matches_the_whole_name
cases.about: a glob is matched whole: dar finds nothing in a.dart, and a folder's name is never a match

cases.name: tree_glob_regex_characters_are_themselves
cases.about: '+', '[' and ']' are themselves in a glob, never a regular expression

cases.name: tree_glob_plus_is_itself
cases.about: a+b.txt names one file, not aab.txt nor ab.txt

cases.name: glob_with_a_slash_is_refused
cases.about: a glob matches a name, so a '/' in it is refused

cases.name: glob_empty_is_refused
cases.about: an empty glob is refused

cases.name: glob_over_max_glob_is_refused
cases.about: a glob longer than max_glob is refused before any walk

cases.name: glob_at_max_glob_is_taken
cases.about: a glob of exactly max_glob characters is taken

cases.name: glob_over_max_wildcards_is_refused
cases.about: a glob with more than max_wildcards '*' is refused before any walk

cases.name: grep_glob_narrows_the_files_searched
cases.about: with a glob, only files whose name matches are searched, and the reply echoes it

cases.name: grep_wildcard_star_spans_any_run
cases.about: with wildcard, '*' spans any run within a line, and the reply carries wildcard: true

cases.name: grep_wildcard_star_never_spans_lines
cases.about: a wildcard is matched within one line: baz on one line and foo on a later one is no match

cases.name: grep_without_wildcard_star_is_itself
cases.about: without wildcard a '*' is itself: a*b finds the line holding a*b, never ab

cases.name: grep_wildcard_regex_characters_are_themselves
cases.about: a wildcard pattern is not a regular expression: (a+)+$ finds itself, never aaa

cases.name: grep_wildcard_of_only_stars_is_refused
cases.about: a wildcard pattern needs a character other than '*'

cases.name: grep_wildcard_over_max_wildcards_is_refused
cases.about: a wildcard pattern with more than max_wildcards '*' is refused before any file is read

cases.name: grep_literal_may_hold_many_stars
cases.about: max_wildcards bounds a wildcard pattern only: a literal pattern of 17 '*' is searched

cases.name: grep_wildcard_pathological_pattern_finishes_within_the_deadline
cases.about: the worst admitted wildcard (max_wildcards '*' between 'a's, no 'b' anywhere) over a 200,000-character line of 'a' answers no match, within search_deadline_ms

cases.name: tree_glob_pathological_glob_finishes_within_the_deadline
cases.about: a glob of max_wildcards '*' between 'a's, ending 'b', over a 204-character name of 'a's answers no match, within search_deadline_ms
